results.behavior: The full session target passes 188 tests on Linux and Intel macOS. Thirteen new tests check hand-derived entry/call/name triples and the synthetic results from transform_messages with stored and injectively rewritten ids: branches, compaction, context edits, aborted/errored and unreadable messages, user/assistant boundaries, repeated ids, system/custom/shell messages. The last leaf is checked at every byte truncation; every leaf is checked at each line boundary. The reopen/repair test also retains unanswered calls. This predicts provider-visible synthetic results, not raw durable path history or external effects. The helper has no product caller and changes no request.

32 preflight gates pass. Actionlint is unavailable; the runtime suite is not selected for a Rust-only diff. Both existing TypeScript PTYs and native Rust PTYs pass. Counts on the command are gates, not Cargo cases; filtered-out tests in the focused controls are not counted as skipped. No live-model eval ran.

Three native gates pass: check:rust, Rust PTYs, and keyless eval fixtures. Two Rust PTY scenarios explicitly skip because they require Linux /proc process state. The command tested snapshot f35159b75b86c5960e5349654f5e02fc1973e526; its complete tree c3e4809e1db608ade7d7fa5db35542f44aa5972e equals candidate 32394c11f5, verified with git rev-parse locally and on the Mac. Logs were copied from the isolated Mac checkout.
